flow.notes: TRIGGER — Fires when a prospect books a call via the Calendly link sent in the outreach email.
LOOKUP — Searches the prospect sheet by email to pull their full record (talent type, event date, budget, etc.).
CALENDAR EVENT — Creates a Google Calendar event for the booking call with all prospect details in the description.

mapper.subject: Your Booking Call is Confirmed! — {{2.talentType}} for {{2.eventType}}
mapper.htmlBody:
Hi {{1.inviteeName}},

Great news! Your booking consultation call is confirmed for {{formatDate(1.eventStartTime, 'MMMM Do, YYYY [at] h:mm A')}}.

Here's what we'll cover:

  • Available {{2.talentType}} talent for your {{2.eventType}}
  • Pricing and packages within your budget
  • Timeline and logistics for {{2.eventDate}}

If you need to reschedule, simply use the link in your original calendar invite.

Looking forward to it!

Best,
[Your Name]
[Your Agency]

flow.notes: CONFIRMATION EMAIL — Sends a professional confirmation email to the prospect summarizing the call time and agenda.
UPDATE STATUS — Updates the prospect's status to 'Call Scheduled' with the date, keeping the pipeline accurate.
CRM UPDATE — Promotes the contact to 'Sales Qualified Lead' in HubSpot since they've booked a call.
SLACK NOTIFICATION — Alerts the bookings team channel so an agent can prepare for the upcoming call.

scenario.name: Scenario 2: Booking Confirmation & Scheduling
scenario.description: When a prospect books a call via Calendly, creates a calendar event, sends confirmation email, updates CRM, and notifies the team.
